intent: The dedicated easing inspector section: pick an easing preset, hand-edit its cubic-bézier curve, and choose what the change applies to.
guidance: The deep end of the 'basic inline, Custom → a dedicated inspector' easing split: AnimatePanel's inline easing routes 'Custom…' here, the one canonical curve editor. It renders and emits only — editable when value.editable !== false and onChange is wired. The preset dropdown always offers every preset plus Custom; the Curve/Spring segmented control is export parity (Spring picks the spring preset, Curve keeps a hand-editable cubic), and editing any handle or number switches the preset to 'custom'. Draggable control points appear only on the custom preset: drag emits live points, onCurveEditCommit commits, Escape or unmount cancels to the start value, and an interactionKey change cancels an active gesture. Apply-to is a real engine scope only with onApplyScopeChange; pass applyToLabel for a disabled, host-owned single-target description.

anatomy.description: PanelSection 40px "Easing" title; landmark makes the section a region labelled by that title.
Full-width Dropdown trigger opening a radio menu of every EASING_PRESET plus a divider and Custom (32px row).
Two-segment SegmentedControl — Spring selects the spring preset, Curve keeps the hand-editable cubic (32px).
112px panel holding an SVG: dashed linear reference, the cubic-bézier curve, two tangent handle lines, and (custom preset only) two draggable control-point handles.
PanelFieldRow "Control points": two NumericInput pairs — X1/Y1 on the left, X2/Y2 on the right.
PanelFullRow "Cubic": the formatted cubic string in a bg-secondary chip with a Copy action that writes cubic-bezier(…) to the clipboard.
PanelFullRow "Apply to": a Dropdown of scope labels (This segment / All segments on this property / layer / slide) or, with applyToLabel, a disabled host-target description.

use_when: Editing an animation segment's easing in depth — presets plus a hand-editable cubic-bézier curve.
Hosting the canonical curve editor that AnimatePanel's inline 'Custom…' easing opens into.
dont_use_when: Offering only the common named easings — keep those inline in the animation card and hand off here on Custom.
Editing transition style, duration, or intensity — those are their own Animate rows/inspector.
states: disabled (no onChange or value.editable === false — preview at opacity-60, controls disabled)
preset: custom (two draggable role=slider handles shown)
dragging (control-point gesture active; Escape or interactionKey change cancels)
focus-visible (keyboard focus ring on a control-point handle)

tokens.note: No hex color literals — every colour flows through c-* utilities or var(--color-c-*). But the cubic readout hardcodes its type (text-[11px] leading-[16px] font-[450] tracking-[0.055px]) instead of a type token, and the disabled preview uses a literal opacity-60; layout also carries hardcoded pixels (mx-[16px] my-[8px] h-[112px], the 200×112 viewBox, size-[18px] handles).

a11y.role: region — the Easing section is a PanelSection with landmark, labelled by its 'Easing' title via aria-labelledby.
a11y.menus: the preset and Apply-to triggers are Dropdowns with aria-haspopup="menu" and an aria-label; menu rows use selectionRole="radio" with checked reflecting the current value.
a11y.curve handles: each control point is a <button role="slider"> with aria-label, aria-valuemin/max/now, aria-valuetext (X/Y), and aria-keyshortcuts for the arrow-key nudges (Shift = coarse step).
a11y.controls: the NumericInputs, the Curve/Spring segmented control, and the Copy action all carry aria-labels.
a11y.preview: the <svg> is aria-label "Easing curve preview"; a trailing sr-only span mirrors the export curve path.
